description: ADVERT CONSENT FOR TEMPORARY BANNERS TO BE DISPLAYED DURING 2026 WIMBLEDON CHAMPIONSHIPS.
decision_conditions: <p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 11px;">The subject matter of the proposed temporary advertisement banner shall relate to&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 11px;">the Wimbledon Lawn Tennis Championships as shown on the submitted photo&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 11px;">montage received 23/02/2026.</span></p><p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 11px;"><br></span></p><p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 11px;">Reason: In the interests of visual amenity and to ensure that the temporary&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 11px;">advertisement is appropriate for display during the Wimbledon Tennis Fortnight.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 11px;">Owner's Permissio</span></u><span style="font-size: 11px;">n - No advertisement is to be displayed
without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an
interest in the site entitled to grant permission.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><u><span style="font-size: 11px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 11px;">:  To accord
with Regulation 14 of the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements)
(England) Regulations 2007.</span></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 11px;"><u>﻿</u></span><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><u><span style="font-size: 11px;">Hazards</span></u><span style="font-size: 11px;"> - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to endanger
persons using any highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil
or military), obscure or hinder the ready interpretation of any traffic sign,
railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air, or hinder the operation of
any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring
the speed of any vehicle.</span></span></p><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
